about: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.105 in ACP mode, SIGNED IN, recorded on Windows 11, 2026-11-06 with the office readiness check: copilot --acp --no-auto-update --disable-builtin-mcps --log-dir <temp>, cwd %SystemRoot%, initialize with fs and terminal, session/list, session/new with mcpServers [], session/list, session/close, session/list. No prompt was sent. Redacted: the session id, the login command path, and the available_commands_update list is cut to 3 of its 100 entries (the rest are the owner's own skills). No account name, token or user id appears in any answer.
